title: dkd-trajectory: Transformer-based prediction of kidney function trajectories in diabetic kidney disease
description:
Analysis code for a study predicting kidney-function trajectories in diabetic kidney disease from electronic health records.

The repository holds code only — no patient data and no model checkpoints. It covers the full pipeline: preprocessing of the hospital EHR export into model-ready tensors, the heterogeneous Performer model and its training driver, the conventional baselines (logistic regression, SVM, LightGBM, XGBoost) through PyCaret, and the analyses behind the reported metrics, figures, feature importances and robustness checks.

Two binary endpoints are supported and defined once: CKD-stage progression, and a sustained eGFR decline to 70% of baseline or less, each evaluated at 1, 3, 5 and 10 years from the index date.
